Nashville, I gotta miss something tonight.
[MUSIC]
Oh no, here we go.
[MUSIC]
Nana, for real.
[MUSIC]
You got me standing different lately.
[MUSIC]
Little more calm, little less crazy.
[MUSIC]
Used to walk in, holding back.
[MUSIC]
Now, just let the moment happen naturally.
[MUSIC]
And every time you look at me like there's nothing I gotta prove.
Something inside me finally settles.
And starts moving to a different groove.
Boy, I noticed that about you from the second that we met.
And you stopped trying so hard to impress me.
And that's what made me interested.
>> Cuz you don't feel like pressure.
You don't feel like performance.
You just feel like somebody finally comfortable in your own skin and
damn, it feels good.
Hard, wide open, the damn it feels good.
Like we finally breathe in the way we always should.
No more hiding, no more standing still.
Till now we're moving with the music and
loving how it feels.
>> Okay, that groove right there dangerous.
You don't want making it dangerous tonight.
[MUSIC]
>> I watched you loosen up your shoulders.
Watched your whole energy change.
Funny how somebody feels stronger when they ain't afraid to be seen.
>> And every time you laugh out loud, this whole room lights up with you.
Turns out confident skits are real attractive.
When it finally starts sounding true.
>> Well, you got me talking honest in front of all these people tonight.
Normally I've doused these feelings, now I'm damn near running toward the life.
Wait, that sounded smooth as hell.
>> See?
>> That's what happens when you stop overthinking.
Break that down somebody.
>> You make this whole room softer in the best possible way.
Like everybody finally breathing instead of trying to be okay.
>> And you make me want to trust the moment.
Instead of gutting every part of me.
Funny how two people open wide up when they finally feel free.
>> Hard, wide open.
>> And I can feel it tonight.
And damn it feels good wide open.
>> Oh, now it's still singing tonight.
Maybe this is what it feels like when somebody really sees your soul.
Not trying to fix you, not trying to change you, just making you feel whole.
Maybe heaven ain't a far off place.
Maybe it's right here in this town.
When two people stop pretending and finally let their hearts be loud.
>> Oh, hell, well you gotta hit me with lines like that live.
>> Because Nashville deserves honesty.
>> Hard wide open and damn it feels good.
>> Like we finally breathing, the way we always should.
>> No more hiding, no more hiding.
>> No more standing still, no more standing.
>> Tonight we're moving with the music.
>> You're loving how it feels.
[MUSIC]
>> Nashville, you're making this one feel real tonight.
>> Hard wide open and damn it feels good.
>> Hard wide open and damn it feels good.
[MUSIC]
>> Hard wide open and damn it feels good.
[MUSIC]
(audience cheering)

>> Open to you.
(upbeat music)

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Can we slow this whole room down for a minute tonight?
>> [APPLAUSE]
>> Yeah.
>> Just breathe with us for this one.
[MUSIC]
>> Somewhere through the smoky mountains I pull that old truck off the road.
[MUSIC]
Skies still heavy with stone clouds, heart still carrying a heavy load.
[MUSIC]
I stepped out into the silence, just trying to clear my mind.
[MUSIC]
Somewhere between my breathing I swear.
[MUSIC]
Life started talking this time.
[MUSIC]
The wind moves slow through the trees like heaven try not to rush you.
Like the whole world, you finally start running from yourself.
[MUSIC]
And in the moment between my breath, the clouds started breaking apart.
So let's build across those mountains, straight into my heart.
[MUSIC]
And for the first time in a long time, you weren't fighting where you stood.
You finally saw your life exactly the way you should.
In the moment between my breath, I felt the sunlight finally land.
Like every road in every heart night was leading to this moment in my hands.
And all the love I thought was leaving was waiting patiently somehow.
Cuz what I thought was far behind me was finally finding me now.
Damn.
[MUSIC]
This room got real still.
[MUSIC]
That's because they're feeling it with you.
[MUSIC]
Music always lived inside me, even when I pushed it away.
[MUSIC]
Like a dream I got too scared to hold.
So I buried it beneath the paint.
[MUSIC]
But standing there beside those mountains, with the sun set for it gold.
[MUSIC]
I realized some dream of state patience, waiting for your soul to come home.
[MUSIC]
And maybe love was never hiding, maybe your heart just needed time to become safe enough.
To finally let me love the right.
Cuz I spent years trying to survive, instead of letting myself live.
And somewhere between those breaths that night, I finally learned how to receive.
Between my breaths, you finally let yourself believe.
[MUSIC]
Maybe the whole point of healing, is learning how to sit still long enough.
To know this life, already trying to love you.
[MUSIC]
Thank y'all, you're sharing this silence with us tonight.
[MUSIC]
In the moment between my breath, I felt the sunlight finally lit.
Like every road and every hard night, was leading to this moment in my hands.
And all the love I thought was leading, was waiting patiently somehow.
Cuz what I thought was far behind me, was finally finding me now.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]
[MUSIC]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
You know, some people got a person they can call when life gets heavy.
[MUSIC]
For me, it was always music.
[MUSIC]
There were nights I couldn't talk to nobody.
Couldn't untangle what lived in my chest.
The whole world fell out and distant, but that old sick stream of the rest.
[MUSIC]
I sit there with a pin in silence, trying to survive another storm.
[MUSIC]
Somehow every broken feeling turned into a melody, warm enough to hold.
Music never asked you to be stronger, never told you how to feel.
It just sat there in the darkness and loved you on a stingray.
Because music will listen like nobody else listens.
Never judged before the tears I had, never turned away from my heart.
And every time I thought life would got me, a song would wrap around my soul.
Like spirit reaching through the silence, trying to remind me I was never alone.
The melody of me, lies somewhere between these strings.
Between every scar and every dream.
And every painful thing.
The melody of me, was there when nobody could see.
And every time the world got heavy, music carried me.
[MUSIC]
That one feels like home, yeah, it kinda is.
[MUSIC]
Some people pray with folded hands.
Some people search for signs above, and spirit always spoke to me.
Through chords and rhythm and love.
Through songs that found me a midnight.
The melodies that knew my pain.
The words I didn't know I carried until they poured out like rain.
And every time you play honestly, you can feel this whole room breathe.
Like you're so funny, saying out loud, everything you needed to believe.
Music never tried to fix me, never asked me to pretend.
It just sat beside me patiently, like the truest kind of friend.
[APPLAUSE]
Oh hell, this is one hard to sing without feeling every inch of it.
Good.
That means it's real.
The melody of me, you were never alone.
He'll look it right now.
I think music was trying to guide me all along.
Trying to lead me back to myself.
One song at a time.
Maybe that's why songs feel like.
Because spirit breathes through truth.
And every time somebody sings honestly.
Another heart remembers it so too.
The melody of me laughs somewhere between these dreams.
Between every score and every dream.
And every painful thing.
The melody of me was there when nobody could see.
And every time the world got happy, music carried me.
[MUSIC PLAYING]
Nashville.
Yeah.
Thank you all for listening to my heart tonight.
The melody of me.
Yeah.
The melody of me.
The melody of me.
[MUSIC PLAYING]
(audience cheering)

money low and faith running high, sleeping with a road to life

then one morning in Athens Tennessee and I came tapping on my door

sometimes heaven sends reminders when you're spirit wearing thin

you are. Eiffel's Tennessee and you. One Lord and every day. Oh no. One Lord and every day.
One Lord and every day. One Lord and every day.
Every day. Woo!
[Music]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
You know, I spent a whole lot of years trying to introduce myself to everybody else.
[MUSIC]
Trying to explain who I was, trying to earn love, trying to prove my worth.
[MUSIC]
And somewhere along the way, I forgot to sit down and actually meet myself.
[MUSIC]
But lately, I've been getting to know this man underneath all the survive,
underneath the fear, underneath the performance, and honestly, I kind of love him.
[MUSIC]
Not from ego, not from arrogance, from gratitude.
[MUSIC]
Because this man survived things that he almost convinced him, he wasn't worth loving.
[MUSIC]
So tonight, this is a love song to me.
[MUSIC]
Let me introduce myself to me, not the scared boy I used to be.
Not the man still betting for worth, not the soul hiding underneath him.
Let me meet the heart that kept surviving through every storm life kept providing.
The one that still chose love somehow, even when pain tried breaking him down.
[MUSIC]
I used to think self love was selfish, like somehow caring meant pride.
But now I see a starving spirit, needs compassion from inside.
And if I can't sit beside my own heart, and love it tenderly, then how could I ever truly offer real love honestly?
>> Love begins with him.
>> So let me introduce myself to the soul I almost lost.
The one who kept on loving, no matter what the cost and every scar he carries.
Now looks beautiful to me, cuz every broken road helped bring him home to peace.
[MUSIC]
I forgive the years I doubted, the years I fought myself inside, the years I searched for validation while my own heart stood outside.
Cuz truthfully, the love I searched for everywhere was quietly waiting for me inside my own soul the whole damn time.
Hey there, I'm sorry it took me so long to finally see your worth but I see you now.
>> So let me introduce myself to the man I'm proud to be, not perfect, not flawless, just human.
And I'm finally free, and if this heart can love itself without shame or apology, then maybe that's same love.
Help set other people free.
>> Nashville, be gentle with yourselves.
[MUSIC]
(crowd cheering)
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Sitting in a lawn chair bare feet on old woodboards
Trying to ride a feeling nobody's ever heard before
Little no book in my left hand, cheap guitar across my knee
Just hoping maybe somewhere down the line
These words might become me
[APPLAUSE]
Recorded demos in the midnight
Name is probably hated every chord
But every rough and broken little song
Made me want this even more
It starts real smart
Almost invisible
Just one little spot
Saying don't let go
At first, it don't even feel real
It just feels important
[MUSIC]
Started posting
Started posting little videos
30 views fell huge back then
Refreshing pages every five minutes
Wondering if this road would ever been
Played a little bar on Tuesday
Half the room talked through the set
But one drunk guy singing every single word
Hell, I still remember it
One little step
Then another one
Till suddenly you've already begun
[MUSIC]
Then comes the dangerous part
People start believing in you
And suddenly you've got to decide if you believe in yourself too
Bought a bed on microphone
Turn the bedroom to a studio
Stayed away to foring
Jace and sounds, nobody else knows
Learned cameras, learned editing
Learn how to carry all the doubt
'Cause dreams give real expensive
Right before they start working out
One more risk
One more scar
One more mile
Get you where you are
There were nights almost quit
Actually, a lot of nights
Yeah
But every version of you kept choosing this life again
Then the messages started coming
People saying man that song hit home
And somehow my little porch thought started helping people
I'd never known
Then came long drives, cheap hotels, fast foods
Somewhere after shows
Still chasing something bigger
Everywhere the highway goes
Then one night the crowd got louder
Then the voice inside my head
And for the first time in my whole damn life
I believe the words I said
One deep breath
One leap of faith
One moment wave
Your whole life changes shape
And then one day
The life you kept imagining
Starts imagining you back
Now the light stretched to the rafters
Thousand singing every lie
Somewhere in the middle of this moment
I see that porch chair in my mind
See the notebook, see the struggle
See the fear inside my eyes
See the man you kept on building
Long before this dream arrived
And now the song's a bigger
And now the world feels wide
And now the love comes rushing in
From every single side
But honestly the greatest part
Pain even all these lights
It's knowing I became the man
That younger version dreamed about a night
It starts real smart
Almost invisible
But one brave spark
Can become unforgettable
One small porch, one wild heart
One man alone underneath the stars
To one day the whole damn world
Start singing who you are
Yeah one day the whole damn world
Start singing who you are
Funny thing about dreams
They were building you
Why you were building them
Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

Follow thousand conversations replaying my head.

Leaving nothing but us standing.

Your hand-finding mind like it always knew.
Exactly where it belonged with you.

Every little joke every tiny mistake.
'Cause loving you isn't something I do.

No airport gates.
No more.
I'll see you soon.
Just this moment.
This heartbeat.
This love.
This room.
When I get my hands on you,
I think of miles for showing me the truth.

When I get my hands on you.

No more lonely shapes of blue.
When I get my hands on you.

The way I've been wanting to.
All this time.

transcription.text: Anybody have a wake up and have absolutely no idea what country you're in?
That usually happens when somebody falls asleep before the plane leaves the runway.
I call that a fish and traveling.
I call that missing dinner in two movies.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha hahahaha
Coffee in Paris by the river at dawn, watching gold light kiss the street.
You stole one sip and stole my heart, dancing through a city dream.
Bonjour ma sherry!
What's the beautiful lady?
Join her handsome Frenchman?
Sweetheart, you were born nowhere near France.
By sunset we were in Israel, walking streets older than time, holding hands through history, making your future mine.
I feel ancient, deep, very sophisticated.
You got lost looking for the hotel elevator.
[laughing]

clothes, sometimes it's pride holding a Bible, sometimes it's pain pretending it's a
principle. And maybe before we put another human being on trial, we ought to sit ourselves
down first. Be our own judge, be our own jury, and ask one on us question. Why do I need
somebody else to be wrong? For me to feel right.

transcription.text: You spend enough years trying to say the perfect thing.

The one day somebody looks you in the eyes and suddenly you don't feel like auditioning
anymore.
Every love was never about getting everything right, maybe you can't get it wrong with the
right person.
I stumbled through her look and forgot what I rehearsed, spilled my drink, laughed
it off, probably made it worse.
Told a story backwards and lost my train halfway, but you smiled like the miss was
exactly okay.
You don't have to polish every little score, the right eyes already know who you are.
You can't get it wrong with the right person, the wrong words still find the right version.
The plans fall through, the race starts pouring, somehow it feels like a perfect morning.
You don't have to find to deserve your place, but where's somebody else's face?
Love ain't measured by perfection, it's found in a honest imperfection, you can't get
it wrong.
Yeah, maybe dinner burns and the music skips, maybe silence falls between our lips, maybe
life gets loud and money gets tied, and love still pulls those chairs in close tonight.
Every flaw tried so hard to hide, somehow became the reason you stayed by my side.
You can't get it wrong with the right person, every wrong turn still has a purpose, lost
the map, but found forever, and somehow every storm gets there.
We don't need a fairy tale to begin, just too hard to willing to let love win, no score
to keep, no courtroom verdict, just too so, saying we're worth it.
You can't get it wrong with the right person, can I tell you all something, the wrong person
makes you question your value, the right person reminds you of it, the wrong person keeps
going, the right person keeps showing up, that's the difference.
The best part of my story is the real you, every chapter, every mile, every tear and every
smile, you can't get it wrong with the right person.
Even broken roads keep the wheels turning, when the world says love needs conditions.
We ride our own definition, hand in hand through every season, something's dope, need
a reason.
If it's built on truth from the very start, grace will always find the heart, no perfect
script, no perfect timing, no perfect line to say.
You can't get it wrong, you can't get it wrong, you can't get it wrong with the right person.
So if you've been exhausting yourself trying to earn love, maybe it's time to stop trying
and so hard, because the right person will never make you prove what they can already
see.
[MUSIC]

the stories I want the scars I want the truth beneath the shine because life gets

me and ain't nothing better than the real you not the profile not the highlight not

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
This next song already exists out there in the world.
[MUSIC]
And honestly, the original version came from a pretty different place in my life.
A more defensive place, a more wounded place.
And I'm grateful for that version too, because it was part of the journey.
But lately, I've been realizing something.
I don't wanna force change anymore.
I just wanna be a change.
It's truthfully, sometimes the people throwing the most hate.
I care in the most pain.
And maybe instead of fighting fire with fire.
We just love people through it.
So tonight, we strip this one all the way down.
Just heart, truth and a little compassion.
If you hate me that much, you probably hurt somewhere deep.
Ain't nobody that emotional without wounds they couldn't keep.
You replay every moment, you revisit every word.
And honestly, somewhere inside me, I know what that kind of pain feels like.
'Cause I've been here, I've doubted, I've questioned my own damn word.
Wonder why somebody else seemed to walk the ladder.
We all carry stars.
And maybe I remind you of dreams you set aside.
Or old you were too scared to walk apart, so you, you have.
But I ain't standing here above you pretending I'm untouched.
I've at night's my own heart twisted, trying to make sense of stuff.
So if you hate me, I still hope that treats you kind.
I hope someday your heart feels safe enough to finally rest your mind.
And if I ever stirred emotions, you didn't know what to do with.
And maybe underneath the anger, it was just something human in it.
See, I don't think most people are evil.
I think most people just hurt me.
Confused, scared, trying to protect parts of themselves they don't understand yet.
I've had people throw stones and cry when I walked away.
Had people swear they hated me, then still check every page.
And honestly now I see it different than I used to back then.
'Cause pain don't always know how to speak without turning into anger now and then.
We're all searching for love somehow.
Maybe sometimes hate is just a wounded love, trying to survive.
The only way it knows how.
So if you hate me, I still wish you peace.
I hope the way you carry someday finally releases.
And if you see something in me that stars something inside.
Maybe that just means your heart's still alive.
To everybody, still trying to figure life out.
Me too.
Me too.
Woo!

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
He was six years old in a living room, but Blanket Cave dragging while the TV stole the show.
Standing on the couch with a cardboard mic, telling everybody Sunday that see his name in lights.
He'd act out scenes to the middle of the night, dreaming of cameras in the Hollywood side,
but life rolled in with its boots and chains, and everybody around him kept saying the same thing.
Blanket a real job, keep your feet on the ground, dreams don't pay bills, quit fooling around.
So he traded scripts for a punch-clock life, bury that fire deep down inside.
But the spotlight never stopped calling in his name.
Through every late night shift, through every ounce of pain, through every UK and every door slam shot.
That little boy inside him never once gave up.
Yeah, he was my life, was burning deep in his veins, somewhere in the darkness, a black bus to remain.
Waiting on the moment when he finally take aim, the spotlight was calling his name.
Woo, woo, woo, woo, woo, woo.
Mid-30s hit like a wake of call, looked in the mirror, said I ain't done it all.
Packed up his fear and went back to school, sat in a classroom feeling twice.
Reduction nights, storyboard dreams underneath the lights, and the first time he stepped out onto that stage.
Something inside him finally broke from the case, the camera rolled in, the whole room knew that boyhood.
If I was the real damn truth, now the spotlight feels different on his skin.
Like every road he traveled was leading him to this.
From rejected pages, to a standing ovation rock, every wound in heartbreak, just opened up the door.
Woo, woo, woo, woo, woo, woo, yeah, the spotlight.
Thanks some fantasy, his blood, sweat tears and belief, turned into reality.
And every single second of doubting who he could be, built the man standing there ready.
Full screen, starter writing stories, from the scars he survived.
Characters with broken hearts still fighting for their lives.
Producers said kids, ones got sold, crew showed up, and they all went on the gold lights.
Camera, sound, action, long nights, turning dreams into passion.
It didn't seem till the sunrise came.
Every frame carrying pieces of his pain, and opening night.
Hit the city alive, marquee lights glowing underneath the sky.
Crowds lined up around the block, and when the credits roll, the whole damn room stood up.
From a night to a script, to a set, to a wrist, to a screen, to a crowd, to a dream screaming loud.
Every no became fuel, every setback became gold.
And before they told a give up, when sold out, the whole show never spied.
Screaming out his name, 40 foot tall across the silver screen in flames.
Critics called it magic, fans say they never felt the same.
But he remembers that little kid, dreaming through the pain.
Hey, yeah, the spoiler, finally found its way to the boy who can't believe it.
When the world walked away, and now the whole world's watching.
As the key is raised, the spotlight is calling isn't it?
There's somewhere in the crowd tonight, the little kid looks up wide, I'm thinking maybe dreams you've had.
Say the Blan.
(audience cheering)

You might be punching that clock,
all the road you didn't choose,
dreaming will be on the walls of them steel towed world boots.
But don't you dare despise,
the place you feet stand now,
'cause every heart earned mine, still built in something proud.
Be grateful for the struggle, for the breath inside your lungs,
for the chance to keep on trying while the day's still young.
Him, whatever's in your hands, do it all with heart,
'cause greatness gets revealed in how you play your part,
whatever you do now, do it with all your heart.
Lose the rope beneath your feet, even before the stars.
And dream bigger, even when nobody sees,
'cause faith ain't begging heaven, faith is living like you've already received.
Yeah, work your ass off, then let the whole thing go.

saying they believe, but acting like nobody's their real faith walks.

before the ship comes in, so keep your eyes wide open and your spirit ain't high,
'cause the dream inside your chest didn't show up ever by chance.

it feels the way you live your life before the dream appears.

even if your current chapter ain't where you want to start.

'cause what's meant for your soul will arrive right on time.

Already knows your name, whatever you do now,
do it all the way, act like the doors are opening before you hear the sound.
Stand like the mountains moving before it hits the ground,
'cause fear waits for proof, the faith moves first,
and the people who change the world usually start by changing themselves.
Whatever you do now, do it with all your heart,
love deeper, dream louder, trust harder in the dark.
Oh, I can dream bigger than you ever had before,
'cause your soul knows exactly what it came here for.
Yeah, be grateful for the moment, even while you climb,
'cause someday you look back and realize this was the rise and the divine.
It ain't searching for perfect words, it's looking for people
who already believe they're worthy.
So live life, the dream is coming.
Just guess what, whether you believe in I, it already is.
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [music]
I was just a young boy running fences in my mind
Dreaming wide open spaces and freedom I could ride
There was something in their spirit I could never quite explain
The thunder in their movement and the calm inside their gaze
Strong enough to shave the ground beneath your very feet
Soft enough to stand beside your pain and perfect peace
People see a horse and think a muscle does things be
But I swear they see the truth in every human being
Holding on a dream that never left my soul
Open fields still calling me wherever life may go
Running through the fire till the broken parts lie
Strength and peace together in the power of their eyes
Every scar inside me showed up clear as day
Somewhere in their sights they taught my heart to stay
Then I met a man named Charles Gears a gold one summer day
Said you want to see my horses help I couldn't wait
You move with something different there was purpose in his hands
Like he spoke a language deeper than commands
He showed me little details little shifts I couldn't see
Our horse will mirror every hidden thing beneath
Then he stepped back smiling said all right now let's begin
But before the lesson ended he looked straight through my skin
So come back tomorrow son you're not ready yet
The horses know the truth before your mouth admits
You got something turning deep just throwing off your ground
Go figure out what's inside before you come around hard
Headed pride was rattling around my chest
Old wounds in anger wouldn't let my spirit rest
Right and home frustrated thinking maybe I should quit
Slamming doors and swearing I was finished with this shit
Every horse could feel the war I tried to hide
So I came back stronger every single night
Four straight days he sent me home and every time it burned
But somewhere in that fire there was something I had learned
You can fake it with some people
You can smile and play pretend but horses read the truth before the words begin

He's a microphone.
Not every feeling needs to win.
If I want to really change,
I've got to be still and listen.
You ever had somebody tell you something?
And the first thing you wanted to do
was explain why they were wrong.
Yeah, me too.
But sometimes the thing that bothers us
is not there to break us.
Sometimes it is there to show us
where we still need love.

I'm so quick to start explaining

Hear the whisper.

Hear the truth beneath it all.
Not every thought needs a microphone.
Not every feeling needs to win.

So I breathe before I answer.
I pause before I speak.
I let the wisdom of a moment.
Say what it's saying to me.
Maybe grace is in the quiet.
Maybe love is in the past.
Maybe growth begins the second.
Stop fighting every flaw.

There is truth beneath the silence.
There is healing under grace.

Perth.

transcription.text: "Australia, before we rise, before we fight, before we start blaming the world, I want
to ask you something, but if every belief you carry is already built in the life you
keep waking up inside of, not every random thought, not every little sentence that
runs through your mind. I mean the thoughts you agreed with, the ones you
rehearsed, the ones you protected, the ones you started calling true. What if
those became beliefs, and what if those beliefs started leading your life?
Maybe the question is not what do you want? Maybe the question is, what have you
believed long enough to become?
What if every word I'm buried, found a way to grow a root? What if every lie I carry started
looking like the truth? What if every fear I felt, built a wall around my
name? What if every dream I doubted, learned to lower down its flame?
Maybe thoughts are only spots till I give them somewhere to stay? Maybe faith is not just
hoping, maybe faith is what I obey. What if it's true? What if the life I see started
somewhere deep in me? With what I kept to breathe into? What if the door was
waiting on my knife? What if the ground beneath my feet was listening
to when I told? His belief becomes the world I walk through, then what would I choose
if it's true? What if it's true? I saw it can pass through your mind and
mean nothing, but I saw you keep feeding, I saw you keep defending, I saw you keep repeating
until your heart bows down to it, that ain't just a thought anymore, that's a belief.
And believe, shape what you reach for, what you run from, what you tolerate, what you
call possible? Yeah, what if I became a prison? Every time I said I can, what if I blessed
my own condition? Every time I cursed my chance? What if I called chains wisdom? Just
because they felt like hope? What if I kept asking heaven for what I would not own?
Maybe asking open something, maybe seeking clears the blind, maybe knocking means I'm ready
to leave the unbelief behind? What if it's true? What if the life I see started somewhere
deep in reach? With what I can't agree to? What if the door was
waiting on my knife? What if the ground beneath my feet was listening
when I talked to him? If the leaf becomes the world I walk through? What would I choose?
If it's true? If I believed I was worthy? Would I still beg to be seen? If I believed I was
chosen? Would I still bow to disbelief? If I believed I was guided? Would I still worship
my fear? If I believed love was with me? Would I still act like it left me here? Go deeper
than the one? Go deeper than the pain? Go deeper than the story? You keep using as
your name? Go deeper than the noise? Go deeper than the fight? The life you want is waiting
where belief becomes your life? What if it's true? What if the life I see started somewhere
deep in reach? With what I can't agree to? What if the door was
waiting on my knife? What if the ground beneath my feet was listening
when I talked to him? If the leaf becomes the world I walk through? What would I choose?
If it's true? What if it's true? What if it's true? What if I'm not stuck? What is what I call
bad luck? Was the belief I never questioned? What if the key was already in my hand? What if
faith was not a wish? But the place where I now stand?
So before I rise, before I run, before I start swinging at everything around me I'm going
to look inside, because if my beliefs are building my life, then I better know what the hell
I've been building with. And listen, and seek, and see, and rise. That's where this starts.
What if it's true? What if it's true? What if it's true?
(upbeat music)
[MUSIC]

There comes a moment where listening has to become living.
Because truth does not change your life.
Just because you heard it.

and move like you believe it.
Not all it wants.
Not perfectly.
Not for applause.
Just one honest step.
Then another.
I used to wait for perfect weather
before I took one step outside.
Used to call it being careful
when the truth was out high.
I used to pray for open hours
while I stood there holding still.
Asking God to move the mountain
while I would not climb the hill.
Maybe rising does not thunder,
maybe strength is not a show,
maybe courage starts in places
only quiet people know.
Our eyes like this.
One breath.
One step.
One shows I have not made yet.
Our eyes like this.
One scar, one truth, one old chain
I'm breaking through.
Not because the fear is gone.
Not because the road is clear.
Our eyes like this.
But choosing love right here.

Sometimes rising looks like answering different.
Leaving different, believing different.
Sometimes rising is not proven them wrong.
Sometimes rising is finally stopping the agreement
with everything that kept you small.
I used to think that I was broken.
Every time I filled the pain,
now I see the cracks were places
where the light could call my name.
I used to hand my peace to people
who could not hold their own.
Now I take it back with mercy
and I carry myself home.
Maybe healing is a doorway.
Maybe pain is not the end.
Maybe every time you choose you,
you are gonna get our eyes like this.

Our eyes like this.

Not because the road is clear.
Our eyes like this.
But choosing love right here.
I do not need a perfect moment.
I do not need a crowd to cheer.
I do not need the past to vanish
to start becoming now right here.
I do not need to feel ready.
I do not need to understand.
I just need to quit surrendering the power in my hands.
Rise with your heart still shaking.
Rise with your voice still low.
Rise with the truth you carry.
Even if nobody knows.
Rise from the old agreement.
Rise from the fear you kissed.
You do not have to rise perfect.
You only have to rise like this.
Our eyes like this.
One breath, one step, one choice
I have not made yet.
Our eyes like this.
One scar, one truth, one old chain
I'm breaking through.
Not because the fear is gone.
Not because the road is clear.
Our eyes like this.
But choosing love right here.
Our eyes like this.
With my feet on the ground.
With my heart turned up.
And the old lies down.
Our eyes like this.
With the truth in my chest.
I may not know it all.
But I know my next step.
Perth, that is how we rise.
Not by pretending.

One breath, one truth, one step.
But it's how you rise like this.

transcription.text: they say forgiveness is necessary, for healing, for growing, for ascending, some say, even
for God, I think they're right, but maybe not for the reasons most people think forgiveness
was never meant to set them free, it was always meant to set me free
I carried stones that weren't even mine, built little prisons inside my mind, replayed the
moments a thousand times, searching for justice I could never find, every memory pulled
like a chain, every heartbeat repeated the pain until I realized what I held was holding
me as well, bitterness makes a terrible home, even when you built it alone
So today I choose forgiveness, not because you were on the right, not because the story changes
or you suddenly saw the light, I forgive because I'm finished, dragging yesterday with me
this isn't your redemption, it's finally my release
forgiveness isn't saying you're right, it doesn't erase the darkest night, it doesn't pretend
the scars don't stay or rewrite what you gave away, some bridges burned because they should
understand so still for the good, I can wish you peace from far away without inviting you
to stay alone, can have an open hand while wisdom still says no, you can't
so today I choose forgiveness, not because you were on the right, not because the
wounds are vanished or wrong somehow became right, I forgive because I'm finished, giving
pain authority, this isn't your coming home, this is me
forgiveness isn't permission, it isn't forgetting, it isn't pretending trust grows
back just because words are spoken, forgiveness says I refuse to let what happened keep
happening inside of me and that's enough, today I choose forgiveness
what tears still in my eyes, so many things never change at all, so many answers never
arrive, but I won't spend another sunrise living inside yesterday, you can keep the chapter
I'm keeping the rest of my life, I hope you heal, I truly do, but whether you ever change
my burden anymore, because forgiveness never required an open door, only an open heart
oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
[MUSIC]

I was asking you, shall I see Darwin?
[music playing]
That's what they say.
But this time, you weren't asking heaven.
You were asking me.
[music playing]
I saw it in the way smile, like you were trying not to ask.
For a little more of me than whatever I had left.
Having given all my daylight to the bills and to the grind,
coming home with tight hands and a half-used up mind.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Before we do this next one, can I just say something real quick?
[MUSIC]
Baby, the last song, man, I was standing back there trying real hard to keep myself together.
[MUSIC]
Because the truth is, for a long time, I really did believe love was something dangerous.
Like if I ever fully relaxed into it, it would disappear or turn against me or break me again.
And then you came into my life and you never once treated my heart like something disposable.
[MUSIC]
You protected it, you protected me, even in moments where I know I wasn't easy to love.
You saw my frustration, my fear, my sadness, but
it's hard to me that still didn't fully know my own worth.
And somehow, none of it scared you away, if anything, you love me harder through those moments.
[MUSIC]
And I don't think you fully understand what that did to somebody like me.
[MUSIC]
You made me realize, love doesn't have to hurt to be real.
[MUSIC]
It doesn't have to manipulate or punish or make you afraid to breathe.
Real love protects, real love stays gentle.
And baby, thank you for making my heart feel safe enough to finally believe in love again.
[MUSIC]
All right boys, let's slow this one down a little tonight.
[MUSIC]
I used to run from anything that even looked like love.
Built these walls so high around, nobody could get close enough.
A smile like I was doing fine, played tough every night.
But deep down I was terrified of giving someone else my life.
When I met you I was cautious, but still bruised beneath my skin.
You could feel me holding distance, even while I tried to let you in.
But there was something in your eyes that quiet kind of piece.
Like your soul that already decided you were saved for someone like me.
And you never rushed my healing, never demanding more.
You just stood there with your hand, patient at the door, and you made love feel safe again.
Like I could finally breathe again, like maybe I don't got fear, somebody disappeared.
You held my heart so carefully, even in the worst parts of me.
And every time I lost myself, you loved me back to clarity.
Girl, you didn't just love this man, you taught him how to trust again.
There were nights I got frustrated, times I questioned my own worth.
Moments I felt hard to carry, still wrestling with all the hurt, but your love never turned cold.
Never weaponized my pain, you just looked at me like somebody.
Still worthy on his darkest days and God, that kind of love is rare.
Somebody who sees your scars and stays standing there, and you made love feel safe again.
Like I ain't got a heart again, like I can lay my soul down, without fear it'll be destroyed somehow.
You fight for us with open hands, not control and not to miss.
And even when I'm hard to hold, you somehow love me more.
Girl, I spent my whole life scared and loved, then you walked in and proved me wrong.
You know what the craziest part is?
You never asked me to become somebody else.
You just love me long enough, for me to become more myself.
Babe, I know I'm not perfect, but thank you, for never making me feel like I had to earn your love through pain.
Cause you made love feel safe again, like heaven touched my chest again, like maybe real love wasn't something I was destined to lose.
You hold my heart like it matters, protecting like it's gold, and every day you prove to me, real love don't have to hurt your soul.
And if I stand here, strumming out, if I finally believe somehow, it's because your love gives me permission to stop being afraid.
So thank you, for loving me gently.
Before we do this next one, can I just say something real quick?
Baby, that last song, man, I was standing back there trying real hard to keep myself together, because the truth is, for a long time, I really didn't believe love was something dangerous.
♪ Like if I had a foot ♪

One lies enough to tear apart Every promise, every start

And every scar leaves a deeper mark In the place where you broke my heart
You say it's small, it doesn't count But it adds up, there's no way out
A lies align, no matter how slight It still takes the air out of the night
Now I'm left with endless doubt Trying to figure this all out
Now I wonder how can I trust again When even the smallest lies begin to spin
A lie is a lie and it tears apart Cracking the walls around my heart

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
What is enough, I wish I really knew.
I want to be happy life, and I want to mean you.
Sometimes I wonder why I trust the way I do.
I'm in search of a forever love, and I'm always played the fool.
I hope you know just how much I love you.
I hope you know just how much I care.
I'm hurting so deep, deep inside, and I wish you could feel my pain.
But you don't love me enough to trust my heart and give yours away.
Do you love me enough, do you want me enough, when do I know?
When enough is enough, is not trying enough, is your trying enough?
Is my kind of love really going to be enough?
Have I been truthful enough, have you been truthful enough?
Have there been too many mistakes, are we at enough?
There's enough, I know I love you enough.
I know I won't you enough, but my heart feels a pain because enough is really enough.
I'm crying right now, as I am writing this song for you.
I want to be happy, but I'm tired of feeling blue.
I hope you never forget my love, I hope you can think of it from time to time.
I hope you can learn from this break up and sometimes wish you were still by.
I know you feel bad, down deep, and I hope your heart hurts with mine.
Not because I don't love you, just because there's so much you hide.
The next time someone loves you with that kind of love I gave.
Two things honest from the heart, and a great love you will say.
, "I love you."
Hmm.
(gentle music)
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
There is someone special in my life, there's a change coming through.
It's all because of her that I want to start out new.
Is she the one for me?
Well, it's pretty hard to say, but life is way too short to worry.
And not have fun today, so I'm going to jump in.
I'll get it all I have, it is just the way that I am.
Life is too short to be sad.
Give it to you straight girl, don't give me a single lie.
I'm going to trust the one that you say you are inside.
I'm going to wipe the slate clean, believe every word you say.
Start off fresh and new, put love's twist on the day.
If you end up hurting me, like I've been hurting the past,
I'll chalk it up to experience, move on, and find what the last.
I won't let it kill me, make me sad anymore.
Everything happens for a reason, out of it, I'll grow a little more.
So there is one thing I ask, this is all I put on your plate.
Just be honest with you, always give it to me straight.
Some people say to me, you're moving way too fast.
Take it slow with her, and it will surely last.
But I have a heart for love, and I listen to what it tells me.
Well, this one feels like a glove.
I'm willing to wait and see, that's just how I'm made.
That's who I am inside.
I wear my heart on my sleeve, and my heart has never lied.
My heart needs love to get me through the tough times that I am with.
My heart, I always need to listen to.
That's just how I plan to live.
They say losing a love can make you grow cold.
I swear I'll never let it make me anything but bold.
'Cause we all want love, and we all have our ways.
Mine is to trust in love.
I know I'll find it someday.
Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

When you and I are together, everything seems all right.
Whether it's in the day or in the late of the night,
our hearts are connected in a way I can explain.
It's like I've known you girl, every one of my living days.
Sometimes we get caught up in what cards a life deals.
It's time we play a different hand and see how together feels.
We need to break sometimes from every day's way of life to feel just you and me.
I never question why because we make love and just can't touch his mind.
Your hands on my face and our bodies intertwine.
You take me to places I never thought I'd do.
I'm working to show you, passion you never know.
So hold on to me tight, as the sweet night takes a sin.
Let go as the passion takes flight and let our tender hearts begin.
Let's go to a place all our own, where we're flying with the doves.
We let go of everything we make love.
It's a feeling like no other, something that you can't explain.
The way we touch when we love, it's just how we are made as the passion unfolds.
And our love pours out true, let's renew our love, as if it were all together new.
Let's be together until our very last days to love one another in so many different ways.
So when we're missing that one thing, that we all need some of, let's open up our hearts.
When we make love, we make love.
When we make love, we make love.
[MUSIC]

transcription.text: [music]
Today she left to be with an old flame
Confused and torn between two loves
One who she isn't in love with
From the other she's learning what real love does
To a heart when it feels good
To a soul when it saddies
To a man that lost her so much
With a heart that her loves pleased
I know she's scared
I know exactly how she feels
Love is a scary thing
And sometimes you spin your wheels
So I ask this question
Over and over again inside
I hope she chooses my love
And it stops trying to hide
Will she stay or will she leave
This week will drag on and on
And she haven't fun with him
Or is she missing me at all
These thoughts they run through my head
Wondering what she'll decide to do
Will she tell him she's leaving him
Or will she play me for a fool
It's hard for me to take all of this
I try to forget her everyday
So been inside tells me not you
That maybe a life with her could be great
I need to stop worrying
But it's easier said than done
'Cause when she left that day
I couldn't stop thinking she would run
I'm waiting for her return
To find out the news that she has
Who she choose to love
Who she choose I love to make laughs
She's only been gone one day
Only seven more to go
I want her back so bad
Her decision I so want to go
I look at the picture she left me
And I kissed it last night before bed
I prayed for her hard to find mine
So we could be together again
I know our fate is in a higher power
The feats turn out as they do
If we are meant to love each other
She'll say I choose to love only you
So for now until she returns to be
I will hope for the best for her and I
I will still ask these questions
Until she returns next time
Will she say or will she leave
This week we'll drag on and on
Is she having fun with him
Or is she really missing me at all
These thoughts they run through my head
We'll wonder and watch you decide to do
Will she tell him she's leaving him
Or will she play me for a fool
It's hard for me to take all this
(Music)
(Music)

transcription.text: I remember the first day I called, I really didn't want to, but my family kept on asking,
so calling was the only thing to do.
Her name was one I knew, but I didn't know much about her.
We met for lunch one day to satisfy my family's desires.
I didn't want to be set up, being single was what I had accepted.
Loving never worked out for me, and my fear I was contemplating.
But there we were, had lunch and talking, learning more about each other.
But she was a quiet one I had found, and for once I found myself clueless.
Two hours had went by that day, and I would have guessed only one.
I've heard when town flies, it means you're having fun.
I got in my car that day, and I know what to think will feel.
I hoped to be with her another time, to learn even more about this girl.
But with bad relationships coming gone, I put off calling her for fear of hope,
of wanting to see her again, finding out her answer is no.
I heard a few weeks passed, and this woman had crossed my mind.
Too many times, not to call, and I couldn't ignore the hope inside.
So one day, a few weeks later, I managed to dial up a note.
Nervous a little, you could say I was, because another day I would ask for.
I popped the question, and I asked her out.
It's my surprise, she agreed. I would never think this is cool,
but learning more than time would make me believe.
Could this work, could she be the one?
Again, only time will tell, she kept me warm to learn more of it.
And as I did, I began to fall, could she be the one?
I didn't have a clue, but I had to see her again.
Just to see if it's true.
The feelings that were growing inside of me,
were they something from God, but was it just wishing it to be?
I'll take this as slow, as my heart will take it.
The truth is what I'll be, and that's the key for us to make it.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
My bed is warm on a first day of work.
The rise took me captive from the start.
Her beauty was there, that was the first thing.
But what I began to feel totally held my heart.
We started hanging out, we had so much fun just being together.
We laughed, we joked, and I never knew I'd love her forever.
I knew about the other one, but my heart wouldn't stay away.
I had to have more of her, I hope that with me her heart would stay.
So we started to see each other more and more, and the more wonderful it became.
But in her heart, she was torn between two loves.
Not a good place to be, and she would never be the same.
I'm gonna hang on if only my heart can take it.
The love inside leaves me no choice, and the chances they've ever heard of breaking.
Someone once told me something, it rings true as life I know.
If you truly love someone, sometimes you have to let them go.
If that someone truly loves you, like you hope they do.
Their heart will return to yours, to love only you.
It's easier said than done, I want you to understand.
Letting her go without a fight, is gonna take every part of who I am.
She's in my thoughts every minute of the day, in my arms is where I will she stay.
Letting her go is what I know I must do, and if she returns to me, I'll look and start new.
Tell me you loved me one last time before you go.
Tell me again, so my heart has something to hold.
Will you be back to once again, touch my heart, to show your true feelings this time.
So we're not apart, who really loves, but I hope so is all I can say.
Listen to you, I'm afraid, will make some very long days.
I have one last thing to say, you know the talker that I am.
Remember that I love you as my whole heart, and I'm gonna hang on if only my heart can take it.
The love inside leaves me no choice, and the chance has never hurt a break.
If someone was told me something, it rings true as life I know.
If you truly love someone, sometimes you have to let them go.
If that someone truly loves you, like you hope they do.
Your heart will return to you, to love only you.
[Music]

Only to hear from the enemy that you're wrong

Feel like the homeless do?

Let me tell you something, my child
I know where you're coming from
My life was stolen from the thief in the night

Yet at the final hour I seemed to fail
But God rescue me like He said He would

From the nails that pierced my hands and feet

The scars are still there

If only you would follow me my child
Let me love and lead you to Him

Never turn from me when there are thorns in your head
I will never leave you and I'll show you to the promised one

You're on the other side of the world, a beautiful heart, my precious girl.
Through all the prayers and heartbreak's tears, God's plan unfolded.
Through the years in my family of faith, love grows strong, together in Christ we all belong.
[MUSIC]
With each Bible study hearts intertwined, in Christ love true family we we find.
Brothers and sisters so dear to my soul, your presence makes my spirit home.
Through all the prayers and trials we face, God's love surrounds us with His grace and our family of faith.
On so tight together in Christ we shine His light.
[MUSIC]
I searched the world here and far, God's love guided me like a star.
Within His time He revealed the way to the one my heart sought every day.

The love of my life God has shown is a sister you've all known.
Through all the prayers and dreams I've kept, God's plan revealed while I while wept in our family of faith.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Listen up, girl, I'm talking to you.
Life's had a shift in the last day or two from frustrated prayers to a man who can't stop giving you picture stairs.
I'm clueless about a lot of life.
I've had it up to here with its strife.
I know you're watching the app to see if I'm typing to see if I respond and when just know I'm putting these words in a flow that might make your heart in them.
I got something to say, girl, I got something to ask.
The last couple days, they blew me away and now there's one more love and task.
I thought I'd say these words 'cause you deserve the best in love.
I take your heart serious, I do.
So sit your sweet self down and let me do what I do.
Girl, you're my everything, my shine, and stark.
In this crazy world, you make it hard, wow.
With every smile, you light up the dark.
Let's write our story hard to hard for my love by my own, loving you is easy like a sweet melody.
You're the song in my soul to be in my heart, together we'll go far just you and me.
Girl, you're my forever, my beautiful star.
So here's the truth, I've got to say you've turned my nights into brighter days.
With every message, every call, I've found a reason, a reason to fall.
I don't have all the answers, but one thing I know in this moment right here, I won't let it go.
So I'm asking you now, without my heart, would you be my girlfriend?
Let's make a new start, together we can face whatever comes our way.
Heaven, hand, we'll make it through each day.
So when you say, girl, give me a chance to love you right, to share this dance.
Oh, once again, you'll be beautiful, when you are what I love.
Will you be my one and only love?
[Music]
Will you be my one and only love?
Will you be my one and only love?
Will you be my one and only love?

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
I sit alone in my room late at night.
Dreaming of a love that's out of sight.
You're on the other side of the world.
A beautiful heart, my precious girl.
We both had our share of pain.
So many skies and heavy rain.
But in my heart, a spark of nights.
A love so strong, it feels so right.
Across the miles, a heart's alive.
Two souls waiting for the right time.
Through the herd and the broken dreams.
We hold on tight to what love means.
If it's God's will, we'll find a way to turn our nights into brightest days.
[MUSIC]
I've been afraid to love again.
Hardly by the ghost of where I've been.
But your kindness breaks through my fear.
You whisper hope that I can hear.
You see my scars are lovely still.
With the grace that only God can fill.
In your eyes, I find my worth.
A love so pure, a love rebirth.
Across the miles, a heart's alive.
Two souls waiting for the right time.
Through the herd and the broken dreams.
We hold on tight to what love means.
If it's God's will, we'll find a way to turn our nights into brightest days.
[MUSIC]
Lord, I come to You in prayer with my heart so full I live there.
If this love is meant to be, God has through the stormy sea.
Across the miles, a heart's alive.
Two souls waiting for the right time.
Through the herd and the broken dreams.
We hold on tight to what love means.
If it's God's will, we'll find a way to turn our nights into brightest.
[MUSIC]
God, if this love is truly from You, show us the path.
See us through, bring us together, make us strong.
Give your love where we belong, in harmony.
Across the miles, a heart's alive.
Two souls waiting for the right time.
Through the herd and the broken dreams.
We hold on tight to what love means.
If it's God's will, we'll find a way to turn our nights into brightest days.
Together and light is where we'll stand.
A love that's guided by your hand.
From here to there, help us see.
You will one heart, one love, in harmony.
[MUSIC]

Hey baby, I know I'm not always clear, but I'm trying on.
Oh, I'm trying to be near, and the words are right, and the songs I sing, I hope you feel the love I'm bringing.
These conversations, they light up my soul, you've been so amazing, you make me whole, but in this distance, all I have are these words to express the love to calm the nerves.
I promise to love you with all that I am, to walk with you to be your man.
When I stumble, when I fall, I'll rise again, I'll stand tall, I follow God, I hold your hand, with every step we'll take this land.
You're my heart, you're my life, forever yours, my sweet wife.
I thought being alone would heal all the scars, but it's you, my love, who's taking me far.
Your kindness, your heart, it's made me see, the love like this is healing me, but with love comes fears as our hearts entwine.
It's not you, it's the past that haunts my mind, but God's open my heart, and I know it's true.
This love's the healing brought by you, I vow to cherish you more every day, to lift you up, come with me.
When I'm weak, when I'm torn, I'll find strength in this love we swore, I'm trust in God, I'm trust in us.
You're every storm, and here we trust, you're my heart, you're my life, forever yours, my sweet wife.
I fear the shadows of the life I've known, but with you, my love, I'm never alone.
Your touch, your voice, it calms my fears and your love, I find the strength to clear.
These fears I have, they're fading away, with you by my side, I'm learning to stay.
In the light of your love, the darkness flees, in your embrace, I find my peace.
I promise to order you, body and soul to stay beside you, to make us whole, when I falter, when I stray, I'll find my way back to you each day.
I lean on God, I lean on you, with every breath I stay true, you're my heart, you're my life, forever yours, my sweet wife.
I'm not perfect, but I'm striving to be the man you deserve, the one you see in your eyes, I find my way, in your love I find my state.
You've shown me love that's pure and real, in your arms, I know how to heal, with these passing days my love will grow, for in you I find my home.
I vow to protect you, for thick and thin, to be your shelter will love begins, when your eyes I find my way, in your love I find my state.

You've shown me love that's pure and real, in your arms, I know how to heal, with each passing day my love will grow, for in you I find my home, I vow to protect you, through thick and thin, to be your shelter.

Will I begin, will life is hard, with skies are gray, I'll be your sunshine, I light the way, I'm trusting God, I'm trusting love, with you my dear, I rise above, you're my heart, you're my life, forever yours, my sweet wife, in the quiet nights when fears arise, I'll hold you close, I'll dry your eyes, in every heartbeat, in every prayer, I'll be your love, I'll be your care.
I promise to grow with you day by day, to love you more in every way, when I'm lost, when I'm found, I'm turning you my love on the bound.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
We're all driving down this long winding road.
Some with the mountain ahead, eyes on where they'll go.
But the mile's seen endless and the weight is hard.
They forget to look around and see the gift of the ride so far.
My, by night, we're finding our way.
Every twist, every turn, shape, and our day.
We're not just rushing to the end of the line.
We're living this journey one mile at a time.
[MUSIC]
Like a travel, eyes locked on the final line.
[MUSIC]
They miss the laughter, the love, the passing time.
We've got the beauty in the journey, in every twist and turn.
In the lessons we gather, in the patience we learn.
My, by my, the road stretches wide, with every heartbeat we're learning to ride.
The finish is far, but the moment's on me.
We're making the most of every mile we're keeping.
[MUSIC]
It's not just about where the road will be, but how we drive, who we're meant to be.
We can speed through the tripness and once around.
We're taking the sights, let our hearts be found, my, by my.
The road's story unfolds, with every step forward, we're breaking the loan.
The road may be long, but our hearts are alive, we're broken in love, my, I'll buy mine.
[MUSIC]
Every stop, every start has a lesson to teach.
It's not just the end, that we're long to reach.
There's a fury in the now, in the shearing today, every mile that we travel is showing the way.
My, by my, we're closer each day, not just to the end, but to who we'll portray.
The journeys are teacher, the road is our guide, we're becoming the bride, my, by my side by side.
My, by my, we've come so far, the journeys, the treasure, the loves, and the scars.
We're not just arriving, we've been growing all the way, together forever, my, by my side.
When we finally arrived in the journeys, done, although it was worth it, every mile we've run.
I'm just for the end, but for all that we've seen, the journey that grew, and the love in between.
[MUSIC]
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
>> Look, I'm here this morning, thinking about this alive.
The grand love you gave me, to cherish the whole time.
I feel the weight, the responsibility on me, to protect her heart, as you trusted me.
[MUSIC]
I know I've stumbled, fallen short before, held on a pain, couldn't shut the door.
Living in this world, but not of its way, it's tough when opinions lead my heart astray.
I wish I could knock out the noise, let your strength and love drown out their voice.
Speak to me Lord, in times of fear, guide me so I don't let her down.
She's so dear.
[MUSIC]
You gave her to me, and her love gave me life, but love I've never known.
Like the warmth of the light, but Lord, I'm scared, cuz I know I pray to close the door.
But now I'm afraid, I want to listen to follow your way, but don't tell lies.
Sometimes lead me astray, I'm tired of the chains that hold me down.
Lord, lift me up, don't let me drown.
I'm scared, if I don't let you in, I'll fail ever want to love my best friend, this love I know is made to you.
I wish I could knock out the noise, let your strength and love drown out their voice.
Speak to me Lord, in times of fear, guide me so I don't let her down.
She's so dear.
I failed before, but I'm asking now, for a new star, Lord, show me how to be the husband, the father you want me to be, but help me lead me, I'm down on my gear.
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh.
[MUSIC]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
>> I see you covered a lot, a lot, a lot, a lot.
Feeling lost without our love.
Holding movies, playing tunes, I'm right beside you in the room.
I know you miss me every day, but I'm with you in every way.
We're still partners, through thick and thin,
two peas in a pot where we begin.
Oh, don't you worry, I'm still here in every smile, in every tear.
I'm the whisper in the songs you play.
A gentle breeze that guides your way.
Though the world seems colder without me there,
feeling my love is everywhere in the music.
In the long sweet share, two peas in a pot where God will be cleared.
[MUSIC]
>> From ovens, tricks to Tennessee, we face the world just you and me.
When you play those tunes, don't feel alone.
I'm the harmony, I'm your home cheering you on just like before in every note.
I'm at your door, the Beatles songs they bring us close in every chord you'll find me most.
I know you're hurting, it's hard to understand.
But trust in the love we've planned.
There's so much nice you'll have to live, so much love that you can give.
For me, for her, for all we care, we need to smile your laughter to share.
It's time to find joy to let in the light.
Start loving life again, it's all right.
Oh, don't you worry, I'm still here in every smile, in every tear.
I'm the whisper in the songs you play.
A gentle breeze that guides your way, though the world seems golden without me there.
Feel my love, this is everywhere in the music, in the moment we share two peas in a pot where God will be cleared.
[Music]
From Auburn Street to Tennessee, we face the world just you and me.
When you play those tunes, don't feel alone.
I'm the harmony, I'm your home cheering you on just like before in every note.
I'm at your door, the Beatles songs, they bring us close in every chord you'll find me most.
Your wife needs you strong and true to see the world in brighter cubes.
Remember the love we always knew, it's still here in all you do.
So lift your head and play that song with your life where you belong.
For me, for her, for all you see, the evil soul you're meant to be.
So play on dear brother with all your life, for I'm your star, shining bright in every beat, in every chord, two peas in a pot for every joy.
Find the joy, let it begin, start living again, let the light in.
We're still together, through it all, two peas in a pot, hear my call.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

With questions I can't help but make

Start again
Would you hold me close and say

But if I couldn't come to you
Would you cross oceans feel it too
Is your love strong enough to bend to leave your world?
Start again

Dear Lord, I place my hope in you
You've got our hearts and what is true

But if it's your will let her see
The strength and love that sets us free

Guide our hearts in what is true

In the quiet of the morning, as the light begins to rise,
I see the beauty in your heart reflected in your eyes.
You are the one I cherish, the one my soul adores,
and I'll vow to love you deeper.
Each day even more, through every trial, every storm that comes out way.
I will hold you close, I'll choose you every day.
For in your heart I find the love that Christ has shown.
A love that's pure in sacred, a love that I call home.
I want to love you like he loves, with every breath I take.
Through every joy and sorrow, in every step we make.
For in you I see the grace, the light that guides us through.

No matter what set stake, from sunrise to sunset,
in all that I pursue,
I give my thanks to God above and all I say and do.
In His name, all I say stand,
In His name I land the hand,
Every word and every deed,
In His name I plan to see,
Thinking God the Father true,
By Him I'll see it through.
When life brings joy or sorrow,
When skies of blue are gray,
I'll hold His name within my heart,
The walk is righteous way,
Through trials and sensations,
In victory or defeat,
I'll lift His name on high,
For His love is all I need.
In His name, all I say stand,
In His name I land the hand,
Every word and every deed,
In His name I plan to see,
Thinking God the Father true,
By Him I'll see it through.

In Jesus holy name,
I walk in all my days,
In His name I'll say stand,

So let His name be honored,
In all that I achieve,
Giving thanks to God and Father,
In whom I do believe,
In His name I will always stand,
Forever on this ground,
For in the name of Jesus,
My life is truly found.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
I stand at the edge, feeling the weight of a choice.
The good change, the course of our fate.
I know this road is filled with unknowns,
but with you by my side, I'm never alone.
I'm trying to hear the voice of our Lord
to follow His path to wield His sword.
I'm scared of what's ahead, but I trust in His plan.
I'll be the man He's called me to be.
The leader you understand.
With you by my side, we'll weather the storm.
Even when the night feels so long.
I'm holding your hand, seeking God's life.
Together we'll find our way through the night.
Your love so so much, it every single way.
I'm here to guide us to lead us each day.
[MUSIC]
I know you feel the tremors of this choice,
but I promise I'm listening to His voice.
I don't have all the answers, but I'm seeking His will.
And I'm praying for strength for His peace to fill.
Our plans, our dreams, they're all in His hands.
I want to be the rock on which all of stands.
I'll lead with love, with faith and with grace.
Trust in His timing as we find our place.
With you by my side, we'll walk through the fire.
Our hearts in a twine lifted higher.
I'm holding your hand, as we journey ahead.
Trust in His word, by which we are led.
Your love so so much, but every beat of my heart.
And God's embrace will never fall upon.
[MUSIC]
With the night is dark and the path unclear.
I'll hold you close and we'll conquer the fear.
For in His light, we'll find our way.
With His love in our hearts, we'll face each day.
With you by my side, we'll rise with the dawn.
And the light of His love, our fears will be gone.
I'm holding your hand in faith, we'll stand.
Walking together in His promise way.
Your love so so much, more than words can say.
And in His will, we'll find our way.
[MUSIC]
With you by my side, we'll make it through.
And God's perfect will, there's nothing we can't do.
Your love, my heart, through my heart still lies.
And together we'll follow His light.
[MUSIC]
>> Well, you was.
[BLANK_AUDIO]

 [MUSIC]

00:00:07.840 --> 00:00:12.680
 I stand at the edge, feeling the weight of a choice.

00:00:12.680 --> 00:00:15.680
 The good change, the course of our fate.

00:00:15.680 --> 00:00:19.440
 I know this road is filled with unknowns,

00:00:19.440 --> 00:00:23.480
 but with you by my side, I'm never alone.

00:00:23.480 --> 00:00:27.400
 I'm trying to hear the voice of our Lord

00:00:27.400 --> 00:00:31.360
 to follow His path to wield His sword.

00:00:31.360 --> 00:00:35.160
 I'm scared of what's ahead, but I trust in His plan.

00:00:35.160 --> 00:00:37.560
 I'll be the man He's called me to be.

00:00:37.560 --> 00:00:40.400
 The leader you understand.

00:00:40.400 --> 00:00:44.320
 With you by my side, we'll weather the storm.

00:00:44.320 --> 00:00:48.200
 Even when the night feels so long.

00:00:48.200 --> 00:00:52.080
 I'm holding your hand, seeking God's life.

00:00:52.080 --> 00:00:55.640
 Together we'll find our way through the night.

00:00:55.640 --> 00:00:59.600
 Your love so so much, it every single way.

00:00:59.600 --> 00:01:03.760
 I'm here to guide us to lead us each day.

00:01:03.760 --> 00:01:10.240
 [MUSIC]

00:01:10.240 --> 00:01:14.160
 I know you feel the tremors of this choice,

00:01:14.160 --> 00:01:18.040
 but I promise I'm listening to His voice.

00:01:18.040 --> 00:01:21.960
 I don't have all the answers, but I'm seeking His will.

00:01:21.960 --> 00:01:25.880
 And I'm praying for strength for His peace to fill.

00:01:25.880 --> 00:01:29.840
 Our plans, our dreams, they're all in His hands.

00:01:29.840 --> 00:01:33.920
 I want to be the rock on which all of stands.

00:01:33.920 --> 00:01:37.720
 I'll lead with love, with faith and with grace.

00:01:37.720 --> 00:01:42.920
 Trust in His timing as we find our place.

00:01:42.920 --> 00:01:46.520
 With you by my side, we'll walk through the fire.

00:01:46.520 --> 00:01:50.760
 Our hearts in a twine lifted higher.

00:01:50.760 --> 00:01:54.240
 I'm holding your hand, as we journey ahead.

00:01:54.240 --> 00:01:58.160
 Trust in His word, by which we are led.

00:01:58.160 --> 00:02:02.120
 Your love so so much, but every beat of my heart.

00:02:02.120 --> 00:02:05.640
 And God's embrace will never fall upon.

00:02:05.640 --> 00:02:08.720
 [MUSIC]

00:02:08.720 --> 00:02:12.880
 With the night is dark and the path unclear.

00:02:12.880 --> 00:02:16.760
 I'll hold you close and we'll conquer the fear.

00:02:16.760 --> 00:02:20.480
 For in His light, we'll find our way.

00:02:20.480 --> 00:02:25.920
 With His love in our hearts, we'll face each day.

00:02:25.920 --> 00:02:29.320
 With you by my side, we'll rise with the dawn.

00:02:29.320 --> 00:02:33.680
 And the light of His love, our fears will be gone.

00:02:33.680 --> 00:02:37.600
 I'm holding your hand in faith, we'll stand.

00:02:37.600 --> 00:02:41.160
 Walking together in His promise way.

00:02:41.160 --> 00:02:45.160
 Your love so so much, more than words can say.

00:02:45.160 --> 00:02:52.000
 And in His will, we'll find our way.

00:02:52.000 --> 00:02:55.160
 [MUSIC]

00:02:55.160 --> 00:02:58.560
 With you by my side, we'll make it through.

00:02:58.560 --> 00:03:02.920
 And God's perfect will, there's nothing we can't do.

00:03:02.920 --> 00:03:07.400
 Your love, my heart, through my heart still lies.

00:03:07.400 --> 00:03:10.280
 And together we'll follow His light.

00:03:10.280 --> 00:03:20.280
 [MUSIC]

00:03:20.280 --> 00:03:26.040
 >> Well, you was.

00:03:26.040 --> 00:03:36.040
 [BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
I've been walking down this road for years
with the brother closer than anyone else.
[MUSIC]
But now I'm caught in the middle of their fears.
[MUSIC]
And it's stealing away the joy I once felt.
[MUSIC]
But if I'm battles, I can truly see.
But every day it's taken more from me.
I can't so much, but it's tearing me apart.
This way I carry, it's heavy on my heart.
I'm standing at the edge, I'm sure way to turn.
Holding on the comfort while inside I am.
I need to find the strength to make a way and heal.
To trust in my Savior and let Him reveal.
Jesus got me to take away this fear.
Show me the path, make your will clean.
I've been struggling tied to this place.
Where security feels like it's back to the chains.
The pressure to stay, it's hard to erase.
But my spirit's restless, lost in the pain.
[MUSIC]
I see the hurt, but then I understand.
But this battle isn't mine to withstand.
I'm afraid to leave not knowing what's next.
But I need to trust and let go of His test.
I'm standing at the edge, seeking peace and mind.
Hoping for a future, my soul's not confined.
I need to step out of faith, so I'm willing to be.
And let the Lord's love set my heart free.
Jesus got me through the stormy night.
Leave me to peace in your glorious life.
These ties that mine, they feel so strong.
But they're leading me where I don't belong.
I need your life to show me the truth, to break these chains and step into the new.
[MUSIC]
I'm standing at the edge, my heart in your hands, ready to follow.
Whenever you commence, I'll let you know the past.
And praise the words to come, trust in your grace, knowing I'm not alone.
Jesus got me takin' in your perfect will, I'll find all I need.
Father, I pray you'll follow you.
Take my hand and lead me through, and your love will find my place, finally walk in your grace.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

00:00:52.120 --> 00:00:57.440
 Holding on the comfort while inside I am.

00:00:57.440 --> 00:01:02.800
 I need to find the strength to make a way and heal.

00:01:02.800 --> 00:01:08.600
 To trust in my Savior and let Him reveal.

00:01:08.600 --> 00:01:11.320
 Jesus got me to take away this fear.

00:01:11.320 --> 00:01:14.000
 Show me the path, make your will clean.

00:01:14.000 --> 00:01:19.040
 I've been struggling tied to this place.

00:01:19.040 --> 00:01:24.280
 Where security feels like it's back to the chains.

00:01:24.280 --> 00:01:28.360
 The pressure to stay, it's hard to erase.

00:01:28.360 --> 00:01:31.520
 But my spirit's restless, lost in the pain.

00:01:31.520 --> 00:01:35.120
 [MUSIC]

00:01:35.120 --> 00:01:40.720
 I see the hurt, but then I understand.

00:01:40.720 --> 00:01:45.720
 But this battle isn't mine to withstand.

00:01:45.720 --> 00:01:50.960
 I'm afraid to leave not knowing what's next.

00:01:50.960 --> 00:01:56.320
 But I need to trust and let go of His test.

00:01:56.320 --> 00:02:01.640
 I'm standing at the edge, seeking peace and mind.

00:02:01.640 --> 00:02:06.960
 Hoping for a future, my soul's not confined.

00:02:06.960 --> 00:02:12.280
 I need to step out of faith, so I'm willing to be.

00:02:12.280 --> 00:02:18.000
 And let the Lord's love set my heart free.

00:02:18.000 --> 00:02:23.360
 Jesus got me through the stormy night.

00:02:23.360 --> 00:02:28.480
 Leave me to peace in your glorious life.

00:02:28.480 --> 00:02:33.640
 These ties that mine, they feel so strong.

00:02:33.640 --> 00:02:38.920
 But they're leading me where I don't belong.

00:02:38.920 --> 00:02:48.600
 I need your life to show me the truth, to break these chains and step into the new.

00:02:48.600 --> 00:02:57.600
 [MUSIC]

00:02:57.600 --> 00:03:05.240
 I'm standing at the edge, my heart in your hands, ready to follow.

00:03:05.240 --> 00:03:10.640
 Whenever you commence, I'll let you know the past.

00:03:10.640 --> 00:03:19.440
 And praise the words to come, trust in your grace, knowing I'm not alone.

00:03:19.440 --> 00:03:28.440
 Jesus got me takin' in your perfect will, I'll find all I need.

00:03:28.440 --> 00:03:33.760
 Father, I pray you'll follow you.

00:03:33.760 --> 00:03:42.960
 Take my hand and lead me through, and your love will find my place, finally walk in your grace.

00:03:42.960 --> 00:03:52.960
 [MUSIC]

00:03:52.960 --> 00:04:02.960
 [BLANK_AUDIO]

The only swinging, trying to win, but I'm fighting now from deep within, she's still standing, her fate's so true, I keep on punching 'til I break through.

She believes in me, and I've laid a vow.
I'm pushing forward, head up the hip, regretting my teeth, refusing to quit, for her our eyes would each step I take, until the only finally breaks.
Now I'm bleeding, but I'm still in the fight, the past won't haunt me by the end of tonight, I see her, watching her eyes like fire.
She's the reason I'm not going to tie every jab, every swing is for her love, I'll fight for the man she's dreaming of.
This range, laugh, battle, feel the sights, my test, I'm eating it all, and I'm giving my best.
The bell rings loud, the cries on its feet, I dance with the darkness, but I won't retreat.
My knuckles are bruised, my body's going thin, but this is the moment I'd to keep her within.

Now I'm in the last round, no turning back, I've wavered the storm, I'm back on track, she's watching closely her heart and her eyes, and I'm even more than just my pride, with the final blow I'm bringing through.
The old me's gone, I've someone new, I bought my fight, I made my stand, now I'm ready to be her man.
The bell rings now, I'm still not feet, I've battled the past and it's been beat, she runs to me arms open wide, I've won this fight with her above my side.
The crowd fades away, it's just us two and she smiles, seeing the mess she knew, the man who bought who never gave in, I'm her champion, I play my way.
Now in the last round, no turning back, I battled the past and it's been beat, she runs to me arms open wide, I've won this fight with her above my side.
The crowd fades away, it's just us two and she smiles, seeing the mess she knew, the man who bought who never gave in, I'm her champion, I play my way.
The fight's not over, there's more to come, but I've shown it now, I won't succumb, I'll keep fighting, day by day, for her I'll never walk away.
[MUSIC]
