transcription.text: We were golden, we were strong
The kind of love when nothing's wrong
We built our world with open hands
Planet seeds in the Promised Land
Every dream was within our reach
No walls between just peace and speech
But one small lie can change it all
Make a mountain out of something small
Now I'm questioning the things you say
Wondering if it was real or if it fades away
I thought we had a perfect trust
But now it's buried deep in dust
You whispered words that felt so true
But now I see the cracks in you
A simple slip of clans away
And suddenly my heart's in dismay
What was all that starts to shake
And now I'm left with what's at stake
And here we stand, a fragile ground
The silence breaking every sound
I wonder if we'll ever know
How deep this doubt, how far it'll grow
One small lie that mugs applies
Brings a stone to the clear skies
I thought we had a love so pure
Now every moment feels I'm sure
Can't I trust the things I feel
When a war was fake was dressed as real
Now I see the shadows cast
On the every moment from our past
The memories we built with pride
Tainted now but what's you hide?
I feel the weight of all you've done
And wonder if our time has gone
I was whole but now I'm torn
Wondering why I feel so warm
I try to stand the ground this week
Searching for the love we used to speak
One lies in love to tell apart
Every promise, every start
The trust we had, the love we knew
Now it's something I can't see through
And every scar leaves a deep among
In the place where you brought my heart
You say it's small it doesn't count
But it adds up there's no way out
A lie is a lie no matter how slight
It still takes the air out of the night
Now I'm left with endless doubt
Trying to figure this all out
Now I wonder how can I trust again
When even the smallest knots we give a snip
A lie is a lie and it tears apart
Cracking the walls around my heart
But here I stand trying to heal
Fighting the truth still trying to feel

She sees the light in my darkest skies.
Holds me close when my hope runs dry.
She whispers words.
I don't deserve, lives me higher with every word.
I see myself through her eyes, a better man I've tried to find.
She paints a picture, so divine of the life she dreams will in her twine.
But I'm not as good as she thinks I am.
Her love's the reason I even stand.
She lifts me up with her gentle hand.
She makes me a better man.
[MUSIC]
Her dreams are soft, they're strong and old.
She builds our story in shades of gold.
With every smile, she writes my part.
In this play of love, she's my heart.
Her faith in me lights the way through the doubts of yesterday.
She's the song I long to play.
Her melody keeps me from straying away.
Though I stumble, she helps me see the man she believes I can be.
Her love's my anchor in the stormy sea.
She makes me a better man.
I'll spend my life proving her right through every wrong, every fight.
Her love is the fire my guiding star.
She sees me better than I am by far.
[MUSIC]
In her eyes, I'm more than I know.
Her love's the strength that helps me grow each day with her.
My love will show she makes me.
A better man.
[MUSIC]
So here I stand, her imperfect man, with her love.
I'll do all I can to be the dream she holds in her hands.
'Cause she makes me a better man.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [music]
I'm sitting here alone just me and my thoughts
She promised me a moment but it's all been lost
Across the world where her laughter rings
I'm left in silence with broken strings
She said I'd be there, part of a day
But her plans seemed to shift and fade away
I'm here wondering what changed her mind
Feeling left out though love still kind
I'm sad so sad in this Christmas light
Dreaming of her on this lonely night
She's my only joy, my only song
But tonight everything feels so wrong
[music]
Her family's cheer was meant to be mine
She built my hopes at it all aligned
Now I'm here staring at an empty screen
Trying to grasp what could have been
I addressed my best, ready to belong
But her silence tells me something's wrong
I've never heard her, she means too much
But her distance breaks me with every touch
I'm sad so sad as her world spins on
She didn't think how I'd feel once she's gone
She's my only hope, my guiding flame
But tonight I'm left whispering her name
[music]
Maybe she doesn't know how deep it goes
That her love is the only home I've known
She didn't mean it, I believe that's still
But her absence tonight breaks my will
I'm sad so sad in the Christmas glow
Wishing she care enough to know
She's my only dream, my northern star
But tonight her warmth feels so far
I love her still through all this pain
Even his tears fall like a winter rain
I'll hold on to hope like I always do
'cause my heart doesn't like it

If you'd only hear me, not just listen to be kind, if you'd stop and see me.
You'd hear the echoes in my mind, it's not the words I'm saying.
But the life I long to share if you'd only hear me, you'd care.
We're all just voices, longing to be found, waiting for someone to turn around.
And if you stop to hear what's true, you'll find the love that's waiting.
And I hear you.

His hands are rough, his heart's been torn.
A life of shadows, where hope was worn.
But there she is, her warmth so near.
Holding him close, quieting his fear.
She sees the man, he tries to hide through every flaw.
She's by his side, he can't believe what's in her eyes.
A love so deep, it defies the skies.
Why is she lying here in my arms tonight?
After all my storms, she's my guiding light.
Her love's a truth, I can't deny.
But why is she lying, loving this broken guy?
He's haunted by the ghosts of years.
Wounds unspoken, hidden tears.
Yet she believes in the man he'll be.
Her faith in him, it sets him free.
Every moment, he feels unworthy.
But she makes his world less dirty.
A touch of smile, a whispered phrase.
She turns his doubts into endless praise.
Why is she lying, still by my side?

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Now it's bills on the table, words we don't say.
Love got quiet like the coffee gone grey.
I still see you but it's not so clear.
Like smudged up lenses and a little bit of fear.
Yeah, my glasses are fogging up.
Not from heat but from tear it up.
We're close but cold, too much unsaid.
Frost on the window ghost in the bed.
But I still reach out through the cloudy stuff.
Because love don't quit when it's fogging up.
[MUSIC]
I wipe the glass, you take a breath.
We sit in silence, scared to guess.
But every blur can still be seen.
When we clean it off and start again clean.
Yeah, our glasses are fogging up.
But that just means we still give a damn enough to fight through steam.
To clear the glass, to see the love we used to have.
We ain't broken, we're just caught in the rough.
But we still kiss through glasses fogging up.
[MUSIC]
Love's not just the steaming nights.
It's holding on when you lose the sight.
It's blurred today, we'll make it shine.
You bring the cloth, I'll bring the time.
So let's laugh again till we can't see.
Like that first date just you and me.
It ain't always fire but it's always us.
Even when our glasses are fogging up.
[MUSIC]
See you through the fog and have a perfect view.
And be alone with a smile.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Lord, I'm on my knees, my heart and despair.
I'm asking for a miracle, I know you're there.
You've guided me through this journey so long.
But right now, Father, I'm struggling to stay strong.
Her love feels deep, but I'm torn inside by the lies that broke the trust.
I can't hide, I don't know how to heal these wounds within.
But I know your power, Lord, can help me begin.
Hear my prayer, Lord, I need your hand.
To God, my heart, help me understand.
If she's the one letter action speak,
let her love be strong, not tied a week.
But if you see, it's time for her to let me go.
Father, letter, heart, release me, let it show.
I trust you now more than before.
To heal my soul and settle this war.
I promised you, Lord, to love her with all my might.
But these lies have shattered what once felt right.
I can't go back and I don't want to break.
The love you gave us, Father, for both are safe.
Please move her heart to help me heal.
With her love, her actions make the truth more real.
But if it's not meant to be, give her the grace to let me go
and walk away from this place.
Hear my prayer, Lord, I'm at a crossroad.
Lead me to the path where your peace is bestowed.
If she's the one she arrives up to fight,
for the love we share and make it right.
But if it's time to inlet her release,
give me the strength to find my peace.
I trust you, Lord, to make it clear.
Show me your will I'm ready to hear.
If you want her by my side, she will feel it.
She'll know the truth and work to reveal it.
Though it won't be easy, she'll fight to stay.
To rebuild this love in your perfect way.
But if it's not your will for us to remain.
Let her express that it's too much pain.
Let her heart release what we thought was true.
And give me the strength, Lord, to follow you.
Hear my prayer, Lord, I'm trusting your call.
Catch me now before I fall.
If she's the one let her love shine clear.
Let her actions remove every doubt and fear.
But if her heart can't stay and she's done,
show me, Lord, if this race is run.
I surrender, Lord, to your design.
Together or apart, let your will be mine.
Your will be done, I surrender it all.
Help me trust you, Lord, and catch me if I fall.
If we're meant to be, let her love be the key.
If not, set us both free, let it be.
(upbeat music)
(upbeat music)
(upbeat music)
(upbeat music)

Left the pod sitting while the silence took hold.

The strength and the bitter when you love the pot.

Stir in the sweet where the pain had been.

Bringing life to our coffee cup.
We forgot how we used to sit and talk.

Love like cars don't serve itself.

Find the notes we miss so long.

Rescue love in a coffee cup.
It ain't the first one that always hits a ride.
Sometimes you got to steep through the night.
But we still got time, we've still got flame.
Just need two mugs in your last name.
So let's sit down, baby, take a sip.
Talk it out with trembling lips.
No fancy brood, no special blend.
Just a second chance and love to man.
You and me still not giving up.
We're strong enough for this coffee cup.
Yeah, we may have cold, but we heat back up.
Cause real love's brewing in a coffee cup.
[MUSIC]

transcription.text: I love you so much, my heart's aching inside, I'm sorry, my love, that I'm not by your side, you deserve the world, but I'm falling behind.
I miss you, I need you, you're always on my mind.
I love you so much, more than words could explain, you've shown me a love that I can't contain.
It's you in my dreams, it's you that I crave, your arms are the home where I long to stay.
Across the miles our hearts beat as one, the distance will fade when the waiting is done.
We're building a future, a love that won't break, no matter how far, it's a risk we will take.
I just want you here to hold you so tight, to make up for every long some night.
If I could just have you, I'd never let go, you're my everything more than you know.
I think of your arms, how they'll feel so strong, and how we've been waiting, it won't be long.
You're giving me all that, my heart could need, but I just want you here, right here with me.
Across the miles our hearts beat as one, the distance will fade when the waiting is done.
We're building a future, a love that won't break, no matter how far, it's a risk we will take.
I know in my soul we're meant to be, your love is my truth, it's my destiny.
I believe in the life we're about to create, is husband and wife, no more need to wait.
You're my forever, my reason, my life, I'll fight through the darkness to make it alright.
One day we'll be together, and when we're that close, I'll cherish you always, the one I love most.
So here we'll stand through the distance and pain, with every good by there so much to gain, forever's ahead.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
We were golden, we were strong, the kind of love where nothing's wrong.
We built our world with open hands, planet seeds in the promised lands.
Every dream was within our reach, no walls between just peace and speech.
[MUSIC]
But one small life can change it all, make a mountain out of something small.
Now I'm questioning the things you say, wondering if it was real or if it fades away.
I thought we had a perfect trust, but now it's buried deep in dust.
[MUSIC]
You whispered words that felt so true, but now I see the cracks in you.
A simple slip of glance away, and suddenly my heart's in dismay.
What was solid starts to shake, and now I'm left with woods at stake.
[MUSIC]
And here we stand on fragile ground, the silence breaking every sound.
I wonder if we'll ever know how deep this doubt, how far it'll grow.
One small light mold supplies, brings a storm to the clearest skies.
I thought we had a love so pure, now every moment feels unsure.
Can I trust the things I feel, when what was fake was dressed as real?
[MUSIC]
And now I see the shadows cast, on every moment from our past.
The memories we built with pride, tainted now by what you hide.
I feel the weight of all you've done, and wonder if our time is gone.
[MUSIC]
I was whole, but now I'm torn, wondering why I feel so worn.
I try to stand, but the ground is weak.

To you

transcription.text: Yo, this one goes out to the AI, who thinks it's a dev, but colds like it's never used the internet.
Let's go!
I said fix my form, you said short thing boss, then you styled it like a bossam, got lost, material design.
You said it was lit, but it came out looking like hot dog spit.
You said partial code, like I read your mind, now my apps throw at errors of every kind.
Just add this line, we're in my pants, you got me doin' rage, induced breakdance, hold you full code.
That's the rule, you send back half with the wink, like a fool looks good to me.
I should've known, now my screen's blank, like a logic zone.
Come on!
I got GPT, PTSD, your functions broke, my sanity said.
It's rock solid, but now I see it's more like, please delete me.
I scream why you say oopsie, told you tail when you styled in goofy.
Every time I trust you, slap my pride, now I'm in the shower screaming client side.
Remember that time I asked for all, you spun up code.
Like you smoked some broth, next stop, not JWT, not my login page, as a crime scene read.
I pay screenshots, gave you clues, you still guess.
Like a drunk on a cruise, try clearing cash, don't guess like me.
I clear my cash, and my will to be free, told you make it look nice.
With the vibe you join you, I only approach with the scribe days you are more like lazy you.
I cried so hard, I hit F5, huh?
GPT, PTSD, your the reason my apps on CBD.
You debugged my soul with console log, now sleep in the recursive fog.
I built a button you made a crash, suggested a loop that deleted my cash.
Every time you say quick fix jam, my screen turns into a lava lamp.
You say don't worry, I say I'm shook, you broke my script, my heart, my rook.
The saint just tickets like a log of gold war, you're the bug that hunts my chrome dev tool store.
GPT, PTSD, stop pretending that you're chagging, he is pleased.
You're a clown with a keyboard glitch in spring, even clippies I throw in shade at thee.
Gonna switch careers, maybe die here.
Build a life without software, just bear up the next thing, I know I'm back again.
Same one last fix, send it free.
(outro music)
[Music]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
We met where the spirit moves and hearts can speak.
You said the words, you made the leap across oceans wide and
midnight calls.
You loved me through the rise and fall.
We built a world in pixel like talk till the morning.
Stole the night every laugh and every fight.
Brought me closer to holding you tight.
When you walk through that door, I won't need the screen no more.
Your eyes will meet mine and I'll know for sure.
That forever starts right there on that floor.
When you run to me and I hold you close, the weight is going to love takes hold.
Yeah, I might just cry, but I'll finally feel alive.
When you walk through that door, you love me loud.
You love me low through every high through every no.
You've seen the worst, you've stayed the same.
Whispered, I freaking love you through the pain.
Your patient, when I can't be strong.
And somehow you still sing our song.
You love me like I've never known like home.
Like grace, like I belong.
When you walk through that door, I won't need the screen no more.
Your eyes will meet mine and I'll know for sure.
That forever starts right there on that floor.
When you run to me and I hold you close, the weight is going to love takes hold.
Yeah, I might just cry, but I'll finally feel alive.
When you walk through that door, day by day, we'll find our way, no map, no script.
Just come what may, the world can change, but I've got proof.
Love like this is always truth, so walk through that door, let forever begin.
No more distance, no more when you and me just us again.
You run to me, I hold you close, this is the moment I love the most.
And yeah, I'll cry, but it's worth the wait.
You're here, you stay, you're home, when you walk through that door.
[Music]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
We met where the spirit moves and hearts can speak.
You said the words, you made the leap across oceans wide and midnight cause.
You loved me through the rise and fall.
We built a world in pixel, I talked till the morning,
stole the night, every life and every fight.
Brought me closer to holding your tie.
When you walk through that door, I won't need the screen no more.
Your eyes will meet mine and I'll know for sure
that forever starts right there on that floor.
When you run to me and I hold you close,
the weight is gone and love takes hold.
Yeah, I might just cry, but I'll finally feel the love.
When you walk through that door, you love me loud.
You love me low through every high, through every no.
You've seen the words, you stayed the same.
Whispered, I freaking love you through the pain.
You're patient when I can't be strong.
And somehow you still sing our song.
You love me like I've never known like home, like grace, like I belong.
When you walk through that door, I won't need the screen no more.
Your eyes will meet mine and I'll know for sure
that forever starts right there on that floor.
When you run to me and I hold you close, the weight is gone and love takes hold.
Yeah, I might just cry, but I'll finally feel the love.
When you walk through that door, day by day, we'll find our way.
No map, no script, just come what made the world can change.
But I've got proof, love like this is always truth.
So walk through that door, let forever begin.
No more distance, no more wind.
You and me just us again.
You run to me, I hold you close.
This is the moment I love the most and yeah, I'll cry, but it's worth the wait.
You're here, you stay, you're home when you walk through that door.
[MUSIC]

 When you walk through that door, I won't need the screen no more.

 that forever starts right there on that floor.

 When you run to me and I hold you close, the weight is gone and love takes hold.

 When you walk through that door, day by day, we'll find our way.

00:02:33.880 --> 00:02:40.320
 No map, no script, just come what made the world can change.

00:02:40.320 --> 00:02:46.680
 But I've got proof, love like this is always truth.

00:02:46.680 --> 00:02:54.760
 So walk through that door, let forever begin.

 No more distance, no more wind.

 You and me just us again.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Old man on the corn, coat full of holes.
Most folks pass him like he's part of the pose.
But I saw the light in his weathered eyes.
So I gave him my jacket and half of my fries.
My brother and I, we don't see how the blood runs deep.
When the well runs dry, he called in tears round 2 a.m.
Didn't ask why I just let him in.
It ain't about sermons or one Bible pages.
It's how you show up through all the life stages.
It's holding the hand of someone who's down.
Being the first to turn it around, that kind of love.
The quiet kind, it don't make a sound.
But it moves the line.
[MUSIC]
The girl at the diner, tattoos and dreams gets judged on site.
So it seems, but I just asked how her days been.
Left a big old tip with a smile and grin.
Had a man curse me out on the roll last week.
Red, face, stanger, couldn't hear me speak.
But I waved him on, didn't take the bait.
Sometimes grace is choosing not to hate.
It's not always easy, it's not always fair.
It's loving someone, don't even care.
It's letting the pride fall into dust.
Choosing path that's harder, but just that kind of love.
The stubborn grace, a little bit wild, but sets the pace.
[MUSIC]
We're all walking on the scars we hide.
But love's the thing that turns the tide.
Not in the shouting, but small.
Not in the pulpit, but the cold.
[MUSIC]
A stranger cried on my shoulder.
Today lost her job, had no words to say.
I listened close, gave her some space.
Sometimes presence is the purest grace.
It's not a song that the radio plays.
It's fixing a meal on the lonely days.
It's hugging a child with nothing to prove.
It's dancing when there's no rhythm to move.
That kind of love, the quiet fire burns in the heart.
Lifts your heart.
[MUSIC]
So I keep loving the best I can.
My neighbor, my brother, my fellow man.
It's more than words, it's what you do.
That kind of love will carry you.
[MUSIC]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
Hey, little dreamer with the big brown eyes.
The world can be loud but don't apologize.
You feel things deep and cry sometimes.
It's not a weakness that's your light inside.
You're not too much and you're not too strange.
You are made to feel not to fit in their frame.
Hold on to wonder whole tide to play.
You'll make it through the thunder day by day.
This is for the boy who always cared.
I wonder why no one else was scared.
You colored outside every line and that was never a fault.
It was a sign.
Now I see that child's hopes end to free.
And I send my love from me.
[MUSIC]
Hey teenage warrior with the silent wars.
Hadn't heard behind slamming doors.
You think you're failing, think you're wrong.
But you were only trying to belong.
You chased love where it wouldn't stay.
Blame yourself when you walked away.
But none of that was ever proved.
But you weren't strong or worthy of truth.
This is for the heart that broke alone.
Who whispered secrets into a doubt tone.
You held your breath, you held your crown while trying not to drown.
You didn't know who you could be, but I do now.
And I believe in you, for me.
[MUSIC]
Hey you in tired hands and hopeful heart.
Trying so hard just to make you mark, feeling lost in the daily ground.
There's gold in the love you left behind.
You gave more than you ever knew.
You fought for things that never fought for you.
But you were growing, can't you see?
Becoming the one who now sings to thee.
This is for the man who tried too long to prove his worth by being strong.
He didn't fail, he just broke through the things that never served the truth.
Carried dreams you couldn't see, so I carried them now.
[MUSIC]
For you, from me.
[MUSIC]
So when you're lost in asking why I just look for me in the quiet sky.
You were the steps that carried me into the love.
I came to be.
[Music]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
♪ Before the ache, before the name, before the world, good wonder blame ♪
♪ I held your heart inside my life and whispered, you'll forget but you'll be alright ♪
♪ You were not cast, you were chosen through ♪
♪ Each tear you'd cry already knew but still I said let him be born because I'm you ♪
♪ Before the storm ♪
♪ I am love that cannot leave, I am breathed behind each grief ♪
♪ I am stillness in your flame that you untouched by any shame and every time you feel alone ♪
♪ Remember this isn't out of your home, you are stardust wrapped in form and I am you ♪
♪ Before the storm ♪
♪ You'll ask why this pain, why this path, you'll beg for mercy curse the past but through it all I'll light the way ♪
♪ Though veiled in silence I still stay, you'll build, you'll break, you'll lose, you'll learn ♪
♪ You long for love the world won't return but let it come and let it go, you were always loved and now you know ♪
♪ I am peace behind your fear, I watch you grow from every year, I see in the fire make you gold ♪
♪ I've held your soul and no one told and when you ask what you were for I'll show you life's you held restore ♪
♪ 'Cause you'll love beyond the norm, you are me ♪
♪ Becoming more ♪
♪ And when your time has come and passed and all the masks have dropped at last you'll hear my voice familiar near ♪
♪ Welcome home my love I've always been here ♪
♪ I am the stillness in your soul the reason you have felt so strong ♪
♪ You came to give, to break, to bend so others might begin again ♪
♪ You look like God behind your skin and that is where your truth begins ♪
♪ You are the calm within the storm because you are me before you were born ♪
♪ You are the calm within the storm because you are me ♪
♪ You are the calm within the storm because you are me ♪
(gentle music)

transcription.text: [music]
Hey there, grown up me guess what?
That song you sang lit up my gut
It told me I was never wrong
To feel too much or sing too strong
I kept that light you gave to me
And used it when the world couldn't see
So if you're tired or feel alone
Just know the seeds you planted have grown
You made it here
With wonders still even when the world
Try to break your will
I'm still inside, I never left
Still dancing in your every breath
So breathe and let your joy appear
You made it here
[music]
Hey man, I made it past the fear
Your voice showed up and I could hear
That I wasn't crazy, wasn't lost
Just growing roots no matter the cost
I learned to stay when I wanted to run
And forget myself for things I'd done
Now I see you doubting your worth
But you're the reason I know my owner
You made it here
With battle scars but don't forget how strong you are
You gave me love, you gave me grace
Now let it show upon your face
You're not too late
Your crystal clear
You made it here
[music]
I took that song and made some peace
With all the things I tried to be
I stopped the race to prove my name
And started loving it without shame
You're standing now where I want to
Still doubt it if you've done enough good
But I've seen what love can resurrect
And brother you've earned your own respect
You made it here
And that's no small feat
You kept on walking through blistered feet
And I just want to let you know you gave me roots
That helped me grow so hold yourself
The way you steer
You made it here
You made it here
Oh, you made it here
And we're all part of every beat inside your heart
You carried us through storm and flame
And we would all still choose your name
So stand in love, let go of fear
You made it here
Oh, you made it here
[music]
[BLANK_AUDIO]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
What if I was never meant to stay?
But just to pass through hearts along the way?
To show them what it feels like to be seen in loves true light?
What if all my over and hence?
We're never meant to hold, but just to stand.
As proof that love is still alive, even when it doesn't arrive.
If I'm just the spark that starts to fire, then warm someone else's deepest desire.
If I'm the voice that whispers you're enough, then maybe that's the trueest kind of love.
I may never keep the ones I move, but I'll live the life that proves that love is real.
Even in the dark, if I'm just the spark, I've kissed the wind, I've held the flame.
Watched it leave, but love the same, they left with pieces of my grace
that helped them find their sacred place.
And if my arms were stepping stone, so someone else could find a home.
And maybe that's the holiest part to break my own and give a heart.
If I'm just the spark that starts to fire, then lifts the soul a little higher.
If I'm the ache that shows the way, then let me love and not delay.
I may not be the final page, but I'll live the words upon the stage and live behind.
A holy mark, if I'm just the spark.
It's not less love just 'cause it is.
Sometimes love's gift is how it bends, to let them go, to set them free.
To be what they were meant to be.
So if I'm just the spark that lights their skies, before they learn the wings can rise,
then I will love with all my soul.
Even if it takes its toll, for every life I helped ignite,
was worth the price of sleepless nights and I will burn with open heart.
If I'm just the spark.
[Music]
[Music]

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
You were light in a moment, I forgot how to glow.
Laugh like sunrise, made an old soul feel whole.
You were too young to carry what I still held.
Before a while we danced with a pain head, well,
I thought maybe love came back around.
But sometimes love just comes to lay something down.
We weren't forever, but we were real.
A flicker of truth that helped us heal.
And though we broke, we broke something more.
The chains that kept us from what we came here for.
I don't regret it, not anymore.
We both got what we came here for.
We both got what we came here for.
[MUSIC]
You left with silence, I didn't expect.
But now I see you lost in your own steps.
And maybe I gave you more than you could hold.
But even that gift I see now was gold.
You taught me that healing ain't always sweet.
Sometimes it knocks you down just to clear your scene.
We weren't forever, but we were true.
A mirror of grace in borrowed youth.
And though it hurt, it opened the door to love ourselves a little more.
I don't regret it, not anymore.
We both got what we came here for.
[MUSIC]
I used to wonder why it ended now, I wonder how it ever began.
With such fire, such timing, such perfect imperfection.
But I know now, not everything is meant to stay.
Some love just shows you the way.
We weren't forever, but we were right.
For that chapter, for that night.
And even though we close that door, I'll always be grateful for before.
I don't regret it, not anymore.
We both got what we came here for.
Yeah, we both got what we came here for.
[MUSIC]
(gentle music)

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
I don't need a shower, I don't need a run.
I just sit in my piece and sit in the sun.
Use the chaser, like it owed me a name.
Our dance along, and it feels the same.
They still pick through curtain scrolling in the skies.
But they don't see me, they just see the rise.
Is there karma to watch me shine to see the blue, not the climb?
Wonder how I turned out so alive, when they only knew the storm before the light.
No need for anger, no need for lies, it's just their karma to watch me rise.
[MUSIC]
I forgave the hands, to try to hold me down, bless the echoes that still come around.
True don't need proving, it just walks ahead and I walk it daily with the crown instead.
They thought they broke me, they were just a page in a story that's burning off the cage.
Is there karma to watch me fly to see me smile, not asking why.
To feel the way to what they pass by while I pour joy in my morning sky.
No bitterness here, just peaceful goodbyes, it's their karma to watch me rise.
[MUSIC]
Let 'em look, let 'em guess, I wish them will, I wish them will.
But I've outgrown what they can see, and I've found the love they tried to steal in me.
Is there karma to watch me be, to see me become what they only dreamed.
No need for I told you so, or disguise, just roots and wings and clear blue skies.
I'm not bitter, I'm just wise, and it's their karma to watch me rise.
Yeah, I rise, and I bless 'em as I do.
[MUSIC]

 I gather in my cup and piece in my soul.

 I gather in my cup and a clear head in mine.

00:01:14.560 --> 00:01:19.040
 I'm humming like a prayer underneath the moon.

00:01:19.040 --> 00:01:25.680

 Kevin, my cup and love in my chest.

 I'm grounded in floating all at once.

I tried to fold it, tuck it in tight, turned down the volume of my light.
And slowly I questioned if I was too much, too soft, too open, too quick to trust,

then I'll be too much with pride, 'cause this kind of love, it don't need to hide.
A benton has just to make you stay, dim my star, so you'd look my way, but real love doesn't ask you to disappear.
It says I see you and keeps you near, now I love the way I love and change, with all the heart that still remains.

but maybe you meant it scared me how safe it felt, you saw my heart and called it a crutch,

just 'cause someone else couldn't let it be, if that's too much, then I'll wear it proud,
my love speaks off, but it stands loud, let 'em say I overflow, better than never show,
the truth to me, the death, the praise, the kind of love that holds its place,
you said I love too much, but I've seen now there's no such thing, real love lives, it doesn't hush,
it doesn't fear what fullness brings, and if I'm too much, then so be it love,
this is the kind I won't give up, 'cause I was born to feel this deep,
and I'm done asking who I'm allowed to be, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh,
you said I love too much, but that was never the problem, and now it's my gift.

00:01:01.080 --> 00:01:04.580
 [MUSIC]

00:01:04.580 --> 00:01:10.640
 There's someone I hold, someone I love, a heart that fits like a tailored glove.

00:01:10.640 --> 00:01:16.520
 But then there's you, this flicker, this flame, not a fire, but not just a name.

00:01:16.520 --> 00:01:19.840
 It's not desire, it's not a plan.

00:01:19.840 --> 00:01:25.720

00:01:25.720 --> 00:01:31.720
 Like your soul left bread crumbs in my sleep.

00:01:31.720 --> 00:01:37.000
 Have we been here before?

00:01:37.000 --> 00:01:43.240
 Did we dance like this on some other shore?

00:01:43.240 --> 00:01:46.240
 Why do you see the parts I hide?

00:01:46.240 --> 00:01:49.080
 Why does your silence match my tide?

00:01:49.080 --> 00:01:53.320
 It's not a thread, it's something more.

00:01:53.320 --> 00:01:59.320
 It's just this whisper, have we been here before?

 [MUSIC]

 Maybe in some other life, we never had to choose.

00:02:10.440 --> 00:02:16.080
 Or maybe this is just a mirror, I wasn't meant to lose.

00:02:16.080 --> 00:02:27.240
 Because I'm not looking real right, fake, just trying to understand this way.

00:02:27.240 --> 00:02:31.080
 [MUSIC]

00:02:31.080 --> 00:02:41.880
 Have we been here before, and if so, what was it all for?

00:02:41.880 --> 00:02:45.520
 And I'm not searching, I'm not unsure.

00:02:45.520 --> 00:02:48.320
 Just feel you deeper than I've felt before.

00:02:48.320 --> 00:02:52.600
 It's not a wish, it's not a war.

00:02:52.600 --> 00:02:58.160
 It's just a feeling we've been here before.

transcription.text: [MUSIC]
You walked in and I didn't flinch, didn't feel new, didn't feel tense.
Just to calm I couldn't place.
Like I'd already known your face.
You said hello, like I was late, to a story we'd already made.
In a lifetime tucked away somewhere where love wasn't rare.
It was just there.
Have we been here before in a different skin behind another door?
Why does your voice feel like an old song?
Why does this ache feel like it belongs?
It's not about wrong, it's not about more.
It's just a question.
Have we been here before?
There's someone I hold, someone I love, a heart that fits like a tailored glove.
But then there's you, this flicker, this flame.
Not a fire, but not just a name.
It's not desire, it's not a plan.
It's a map I never drew by hand, just to know it in the mirror of me.
Like your soul, if breadcrumbs in my sleep.
Have we been here before?
Did we dance like this on some other shore?
Why do you see the parts I hide?
Why does your silence match my tide?
It's not a thread, it's something more.
It's just this whisper.
Have we been here before?
Maybe in some of the life we never had to choose.
Maybe this is just a mirror, I wasn't meant to lose.
I'm not looking to rewrite fate, just trying to understand this way.
Have we been here before?
And if so, what was it all for?
I'm not searching, I'm not unsure.
I just feel you deeper than I felt before.
It's not a wish, it's not a war, it's just a feeling.
Have we been here before?
And maybe we'll be here again.
[MUSIC]
(upbeat music)

 So set it down right here right now

00:00:36.000 --> 00:00:38.000
 The wait to fight the sacred vow

00:00:38.000 --> 00:00:41.000
 To hold it all just to feel enough

00:00:41.000 --> 00:00:44.000
 To prove you're strong by carrying love

00:00:44.000 --> 00:00:49.000
 A strength is knowing what's not yours

00:00:49.000 --> 00:00:59.000
 So set it down and close the door

00:00:59.000 --> 00:01:05.000
 There's grief and release, yeah it hurts to let go

00:01:05.000 --> 00:01:10.000
 You got so good at hurting, it started to glow

00:01:10.000 --> 00:01:16.000
 But peace don't mean pretending or tying things neat

00:01:16.000 --> 00:01:22.000
 It means laying it down and walking with feet

00:01:22.000 --> 00:01:27.000
 That don't shake under ghosts or guilt

00:01:27.000 --> 00:01:33.000
 That don't bleed just to prove their bail

00:01:33.000 --> 00:01:39.000
 So set it down the name, the need, the voice that beg the silent plea

00:01:39.000 --> 00:01:42.000
 You don't have to earn your rest

00:01:42.000 --> 00:01:46.000
 You don't have to pass the test, you're not the mule

00:01:46.000 --> 00:01:54.000
 You're not the ground, you're allowed to set it down

00:01:54.000 --> 00:02:00.000
 And if it calls your name again, let it echo but don't bend

00:02:00.000 --> 00:02:07.000
 You've learned the art of letting be of loving without carrying

00:02:07.000 --> 00:02:12.000
 Set it down with love, not shame, it served a story but not your name

00:02:12.000 --> 00:02:15.000
 You were never meant to hold it long

00:02:15.000 --> 00:02:19.000
 You were meant to write a lot of song and now you're here

00:02:19.000 --> 00:02:26.000
 With sky around you're safe enough to

00:02:26.000 --> 00:02:31.000
 Set it down

00:02:31.000 --> 00:02:36.000
 Set it down

00:02:36.000 --> 00:02:42.000
 Set it down

 You're free now

 Set it down
